models.label: ECHO 3T
models.description: OpenCore APEX with an exact ECHO archive
models.note: 3T is an archive scaling goal, not simultaneous attention. Private weights require Hugging Face access.

models.label: 1M extended
models.description: OpenCore APEX with YaRN context extension
models.note: Trained context 262,144; long-context quality at 1M has not been validated.

models.label: DuoCore
models.description: K2 and Nanbeige generate and cross-review candidates
models.note: Self-reported review scores are not correctness probabilities.

models.label: Nanbeige BF16
models.note: Single-model profile using the pinned BF16 GGUF. Native 262,144-token context; speed and long-context quality are not yet qualified.

models.label: Nanbeige BF16 ECHO
models.note: Uses the same single BF16 checkpoint with ECHO archive retrieval. Active model context is 262,144 tokens; this is not unbounded simultaneous attention.

models.label: DualCore KV
models.description: Two identical LFM brains cooperate through drafts and blind reviews
models.note: No BF16 checkpoint is published. One shared 3.12 GB download; two complete weight sets in memory. Native F16 KV/state for the 131K active context; older conversation history is not retrieved.

models.label: DualCore ECHO
models.description: Two identical LFM brains with ECHO archive retrieval
models.note: ECHO preserves the exact archive and retrieves relevant older history; active decoding uses a 131,072-token rolling context with incremental F16 KV. One shared checkpoint download; two full weight sets in memory.

models.label: FusionCore KV
models.description: Two full LFM towers coupled in one token generation loop
models.note: No BF16 checkpoint is published. One shared 3.12 GB download; two complete weight sets in memory. Untuned hidden feedback; native F16 KV/state for the 131K active context. No quality gain claimed.

models.label: FusionCore ECHO
models.description: One coupled token loop with ECHO retrieval and incremental KV
models.note: ECHO preserves the exact archive and retrieves relevant older history; active decoding uses a 131,072-token rolling context with incremental F16 KV. One coupled output token stream; hidden feedback remains untuned.

models.label: Holo 3.1 0.8B
models.note: On-demand computer-use vision. Includes its matching native runtime; chat model and Python components install separately.

models.label: Reflex decision policy
models.note: Optional typed decision classifier. A confidence score is not a correctness guarantee.

models.label: Whisper large-v3 turbo
models.description: OpenAI's multilingual Whisper Turbo checkpoint for speech transcription in the spoken language
models.note: Offline multilingual transcription with task=transcribe (no translation). This is the general Turbo checkpoint, not a Hebrew fine-tune. RAM sleep keeps weights in system RAM and clears GPU use after dictation; cold start unloads the process after each use.

models.label: Whisper large-v3
models.description: OpenAI's full large-v3 speech recognition checkpoint, including Hebrew.
models.note: Full large-v3, separate from Turbo. Multilingual transcription in the spoken language. Uses the pinned F16 CTranslate2 conversion of OpenAI weights, or an existing full Transformers checkpoint. Releases GPU memory after dictation; optional RAM standby.

models.label: Phonon-2
models.description: Fermion Research's English speech recognition model, based on Parakeet TDT.
models.note: English only. About 164 MB compressed download. Windows uses the reference runtime: expanded FP32 weights use about 2.5 GB, with additional audio buffers. Optional RAM standby; GPU memory is released after dictation.

models.label: Swift 1.5 27B
models.note: Optional IQ2_S download (9.26 GB). Quantized 27B checkpoint; quality and speed on this GPU are unverified. ECHO recall enabled; no vision projector.

models.label: Dirk 27B Vision
models.note: 9.61 GB weights plus 0.93 GB vision projector. Tight on 12 GB; CPU KV and bounded 8K attention. Includes MTP weights, but speculative decoding is not enabled. ECHO recall enabled.

models.label: DavidAU Turbo Cold Fusion 27B
models.description: DavidAU Turbo Cold Fusion 27B Â· text
models.note: At least 11.67 GB weights; CPU layer offload is required on 12 GB. This is an optional heavy model, not a speed upgrade. ECHO recall enabled.

models.label: Mirai S experimental 27B
models.note: Requires the publisherâ€™s experimental vLLM plugin. Downloaded checkpoints alone do not enable inference. Text only; setup and hardware testing required.

models.label: ThinkingCap 27B
models.note: About 55 GB of weights. CPU offload or a larger GPU is required; no precision conversion is applied. Requires a compatible Transformers or vLLM backend. Hugging Face access approval is required before downloading this gated repository.

models.label: Qwen Image 2.1
models.note: Image generation/editing and transparent RGBA assets. Full pipeline includes text encoder and VAE. Requires Diffusers and CPU offload on 12 GB; upstream license restricts commercial use.

models.label: Qwen Image 2.1 GGUF
models.note: 6.27 GB visual component only. Also needs Qwen Imageâ€™s text encoder and VAE plus a GGUF-compatible image backend. Do not use as a chat GGUF.

models.label: Animation Diffusion Â· 2D
models.note: Despite the repository name, this is a 2D Stable Diffusion image pipeline. It does not export animated 3D meshes. Requires Diffusers.

models.label: Holo4 27B
models.note: Desktop/browser vision-action model. BF16 weights require substantial CPU offload or a larger GPU. Runtime setup required; noncommercial weights.

models.label: Holo1.5 3B
models.note: Smaller vision-action model; original BF16 weights. Requires the Holo action parser and compatible inference runtime. Not automatically substituted for the chat model.

models.label: SPAR3D
models.note: Image to textured, UV-unwrapped mesh. Upstream low-memory mode reports about 7 GB VRAM. Requires its native inference dependencies. Hugging Face access approval is required before downloading this gated repository.

models.label: Pixal3D
models.note: Image to geometry and PBR textures. Full checkpoint set is large; low-memory mode is tight on 12 GB. Requires upstream CUDA extensions.

models.label: TripoSR
models.note: Fast image to 3D mesh. Requires TripoSR runtime and image preprocessing; weights are downloaded separately.

models.label: HY-Motion 1.0
models.note: Text to humanoid skeleton motion. Upstream minimum is 26 GB VRAM, exceeding this 12 GB GPU. Text encoders and SMPL assets are separate dependencies; not a universal mesh animator.

models.label: HY-Motion 1.0 Lite
models.note: Smaller motion checkpoint from the same official repository. Published minimum is 24 GB VRAM; unverified CPU-offload optimizations are not enabled.

models.label: UniMate
models.description: Rigged skeleton animation. Upstream setup and checkpoint selection required; no verified 12 GB runtime yet.
models.note: Rigged skeleton animation. Upstream setup and checkpoint selection required; no verified 12 GB runtime yet.

models.label: AnimateAnyMesh
models.description: Text-driven mesh deformation. Upstream runtime and weights required; does not automatically add skeleton rigging.
models.note: Text-driven mesh deformation. Upstream runtime and weights required; does not automatically add skeleton rigging.

models.label: ToonCrafter
models.description: Cartoon frame interpolation. Published reference uses about 24 GB VRAM. Requires a separately configured video runtime.
models.note: Cartoon frame interpolation. Published reference uses about 24 GB VRAM. Requires a separately configured video runtime.

models.label: YuE2
models.description: Song generation, vocals, and editable music scores.
models.precision: Original BF16 model · FP32 audio decoder
models.note: Requires the local YuE2 Studio runtime. Models load on demand; existing YuE2 weights can be registered without another download.
